answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 33477 Country: Canada Title: I am looking for information about inheritance for a family of 5 people (1) mother, (2) two brothers, (3) two sisters. Question: I am looking for information about inheritance for a family of 5 people (1) mother, (2) two brothers, (3) two sisters. Father passed away. The property is to be sold and amount to be distributed to all 5 according to Quran and Sunnah. Your guidance will be greatly appreciated. Answer ID: 33477 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1209/774/=1432) In the question mentioned above, if the property of your father has to be divided then all his property shall be divided into 48 shares. Your mother (the widow) shall get 6 shares, 14-14 shares will go to each brother and 7-7 shares to each sister. The detail of Shariah division of the property is as follows: Detail: Wife: 1x06 = 06 Sons: 2x14 = 28 Daughters: 2x07 = 14 Total: 48 shares Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
